coverage_notes: Pinned official template/sample style learning, not a claim that every initial submission must use every sample property.
Typeface, size and paragraph properties come from representative visible content runs; red/blue instruction font colors are not copied.
Word original source is not redistributed; converted part locators refer to the temporary derived DOCX, linked to the original download SHA256.
Character-count indents and automatic numbering remain source observations; no point-indent approximation is added.
Primary title first visible run is16pt black Heiti; the same paragraph red editorial instruction is10.5pt and excluded from title selection.

English abstract has only a9pt black label and7.5pt red Chinese instruction, without actual English abstract content. No English abstract size is executed; both observed sizes remain in temporary run evidence.

extracted_format.visible_text_inheritance: docDefaults + paragraph/character style inheritance + actual visible text run; pPr/rPr paragraph-mark font properties excluded
extracted_format.reaudit_note: Shared engine resolves defaults, basedOn paragraph/character styles and actual visible run; paragraph-mark rPr excluded. Captured full resolved source observations can include editorial colors or labels; executable rules retain documented manuscript content selection and source guidance/COM measurements where OOXML alone is incomplete.
